title: helietta mollis
intro: Helietta mollis, commonly known as the yellow helietta, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the treatment of various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Helietta mollis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antiviral effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
